properties.notes: The Site is allocated as part of Policy SP1 and Policy AOC1 in the Local Plan 2036, adopted in June 2020. The Local Plan identifies a minimum of 20 homes to be delivered on this site. The site is currently undergoing masterplanning process alongside major updates to the rail network. The land area in hectares given on this Register relates to both parts of the site.
properties.site-address: Oxford Rail Station & Becket Street Car Park, Becket Street, Oxford
